headline: Fisherman's Row Rages as Shelf and Coast Stir
war_summary: Since the six o'clock edition the centre of action has sharpened at Fisherman's Row, now reporting fourteen changes in two hours and fifty-seven on the day about Eidolo, Black Well, Arcadia, Fort Ember and Hangman's Court to the filing minute, standing three Warden to six Colonial with day losses near five hundred Colonial and eight hundred Warden. Stlican Shelf has quickened to five changes in two hours and thirty-six on the day about Thornhold, the Pale House, Vulpine Watch and the Old Mourn, last heard at twenty to nine, holding five Warden to three Colonial with one destroyed. Farranac Coast stirs anew with three changes in two hours to the filing minute about the Bone Haft and Transient Valley, while Linn Mercy adds three in two hours about Lathair, last heard at ten past eight. Weathered Expanse, Stonecradle and Mooring County have gone quiet in the last two hours, last turning near twenty to six and five o'clock, though Expanse still counts forty-two on the day and Cradle shows quickening losses. Callahan's Passage remains without a fresh flip despite heavy day losses.
